visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a vibrant orange Nike hoodie and a dusty rose baseball cap is seated at a glass desk in a brightly lit, modern office space. He is intensely focused on typing on a black keyboard connected to a tablet computer. In the background, visible through a glass door, another individual in a dark hoodie stands holding a bright orange, shaggy wig, creating a sense of anticipation or a planned prank. (2) The man stops typing and turns directly toward the camera lens, engaging the audience with animated facial expressions and expressive hand gestures. He speaks with high energy, frequently pointing at the camera to create a direct connection. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom of the frame, providing information about a housing survey in Singapore. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting his features. (3) The individual from the background moves closer and carefully lowers the orange wig onto the man's head. The man accepts the wig without breaking his charismatic persona, adjusting his posture to embrace the humorous visual change. He continues speaking, now sporting the oversized, messy orange hair. The scene ends with him pointing and smiling, maintaining a comedic and inviting atmosphere.
